sources.scope: Original diene-polymer study supports residual unsaturation; not a claim every diene linkage is identical.
Official indexed polydiene nomenclature distinguishes 1,2 and 1,4 addition products. Direct PDF unavailable.
Original PVC plasticisation study: formulation-dependent thermal behaviour. No universal melting ranking inferred.
Manufacturer measurements explicitly separate glass transition for a specified PVC sample; those numbers are not reused as universal values.
EPA primary program description: mechanical recycling depends on feedstock variability, sorting, contamination and quality.
Most conventional petroleum-based plastics are not readily biodegradable; disposal environment and product specifications matter.

sources.scope: Original phenolphthalein fading experiment. Official indexed abstract available; direct page 403. Supports existence of time-dependent alkaline fading, not a numerical pH-12 rate or universal instantaneous colour.
ILO/WHO lithium hydroxide safety card explicitly calls its water solution a strong base, disproving the four-only list.
University original demonstration: copper dissolves in concentrated nitric acid with NO2. This is evidence against the blanket rule, not practical instructions.

RSC authored classroom observations qualify metal/acid behaviour. Indexed official note also reports hydrogen with sufficiently dilute nitric acid and selected metals; therefore do not claim nitric acid never gives H2.
IUPAC distinguishes hydrogen chloride gas from hydrochloric acid in water.
IUPAC nomenclature includes hydrogen sulfide; familiar aqueous acid names are scoped common names rather than a universal naming algorithm.
